# Vendored dependencies

`diff2html.min.js` and `diff2html.min.css` provide the offline diff renderer. They are distributed from [diff2html 3.4.48](https://www.npmjs.com/package/diff2html/v/3.4.48). The JavaScript asset includes the UI bundle.

The upstream MIT license is included in [diff2html-LICENSE.md](diff2html-LICENSE.md). Preserve this notice and the license when redistributing these assets.

When upgrading, review the corresponding published package and update both assets, this version note, and any license notices together.
